result.title: Answering your questions about GPT-Live
result.description:
We’re answering the internet’s questions about GPT-Live, starting with how it’s different from earlier voice models and what developers are using it for. Already building with GPT-Live? We’ll share practical tips for customizing your agent’s voice and improving delegation.

What else would you like to know about building with GPT-Live? Leave us a question in the comments!

result.title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT in beta
result.description:
Now in beta: Businesses in ChatGPT.

Claim your business, manage your information, and get insights on how people engage with you.

With Business Hub, verified businesses can update their details and add product feeds with current pricing and availability. They can also see aggregated insights on mentions, website clicks, and common topics in conversations where their business is cited.

Eligible ecommerce and online service businesses in the U.S. can also build a Business Agent to answer customers’ questions and help them explore what they offer. Customers can ask questions, compare products, and find what fits their needs using information provided by the business—all in a clearly labeled conversation, separate from ChatGPT’s independent answers.

We don’t share people’s conversations or Business Agent chats with businesses.

Eligible businesses located wherever ChatGPT is available can get started by claiming their business in Business Hub.

Find out more: https://openai.com/business/businesses-in-chatgpt
Claim your business: chatgpt.com/business-hub

result.title: Greg Brockman on how OpenAI uses frontier models for cyber defense
result.description:
We’re turning lessons from defending OpenAI into practical tools for our customers.

OpenAI President and Co-Founder Greg Brockman shares how we used a frontier model to identify and resolve important vulnerabilities in our own code and infrastructure. That experience is informing the tools and playbooks we’re building to help other security teams strengthen their defenses as model capabilities improve.

Learn more about OpenAI’s work in cybersecurity: https://openai.com/daybreak/

result.title: How CodeRabbit uses OpenAI to review AI-generated code
result.description:
CodeRabbit co-founder and CEO Harjot Gill explains how the team uses OpenAI models to help teams understand, review, and secure code produced by AI agents and decide what’s ready to ship. He also shares how CodeRabbit used Codex to ship 20x more software over 6 months with the same engineering team.

Read the story: https://openai.com/index/coderabbit-codex-daybreak/
